name: AddressIntel Peninsula Entitlement API
description: Parcel-level entitlement math for the Silicon Valley Peninsula and South Bay: SB 9 status, ADU yield and FAR headroom per lot, each carrying the municipal code section it came from, the date that section was read and a confidence rating, joined to building permits, listings and comparable sales. Coverage is regional by design, not national.
